svg.text: Three telemetry feeds ship into the SIEM; Prometheus metrics and OTLP traces are observability, NOT SIEM (stated in SIEM.md). Set the parameters in the table below to turn each feed on.
AMA custom-text-log · Splunk UF · Fluent Bit
Sentinel Logic App · Splunk HEC · SOAR
OBSERVABILITY — NOT shipped to the SIEM
SIEM.md: “Prometheus metrics are for dashboards / alerting (ops/), not SIEM — don’t ship scrapes into the SIEM.”
Defaults are the shipped values; “Set for SIEM” is what turns the feed on. Every connector reads these (OTEL_* on all five; EVENTLOG_LEVEL on all but Altrata).
JSON log files — one object per line
Source: each connector’s docs/SIEM.md + docs/OBSERVABILITY.md and env/.env.local.example. Event-log source is registered by the MSI / install-windows-service.ps1 (the service needs no admin).
Feeds are independent — use any combination. Webhook alerts are pre-digested (alert-worthy only); JSON files carry everything; Event Log carries WARNING+ for agent fleets.
